sql_facts.sql: SELECT "region", "销量", "排名" FROM (SELECT "sales_orders"."region", SUM("sales_orders"."quantity") AS "销量", DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM("sales_orders"."quantity") DESC) AS "排名" FROM "sales_orders" WHERE "sales_orders"."order_date" >= ? AND "sales_orders"."order_date" < ? GROUP BY "sales_orders"."region") AS ranked WHERE "排名" <= ? ORDER BY "排名" ASC, "销量" DESC LIMIT ?
